Title: ZOTAC | Mini PCs and GeForce RTX Gaming Graphics Cards | ZOTAC
URL: https://www.zotac.com/us/page/zotac-gaming-geforce-rtx-3080-series-12gb
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
rtx3080-12gb

GET AMPLIFIED

 Tap into the fine-tuned balance of cooling, acoustics and aesthetics of the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX™ 3080 12GB Series to amplify your gaming experience. 

MOST REALISTIC & IMMERSIVE GRAPHICS

 2nd Gen Ray Tracing 

AI-ENHANCED VOICE & VIDEO

 NVIDIA Broadcast App 

FAST-TRACK YOUR CREATIVITY

GEFORCE RTX™ THE ULTIMATE PLAY

BOOST PERFORMANCE WITH AI

 NVIDIA DLSS massively increases performance, without sacrificing quality, by using cutting-edge AI. 

MORE IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCES

 Ray Tracing enables the most realistic and immersive graphics, which runs fast thanks to 2nd gen RT Cores.

...

Exclusive to the AMP Holo is the award-winning HoloBlack design embracing an iridescent holographic finish that exudes an aurora like glow. The design captivates your eyes with the RGB lighting underneath and even with the lights off, the HoloBlack design itself is a showcase.

...

- BRING DOWN THE MERCURY

 A more refined IceStorm 2.0 cooling system is purpose-built for wider coverage to keep the GPU cooler and running stronger, with enhancements in the visible and in what lies underneath. 
- PASS-THRU AIRFLOW

 More airflow exit routes across the GPU design including a direct pass-thru airflow vent, which enables faster heat exhaust, reduces trapped heat, and reduces airflow turbulence for overall improved noise and thermal performance. *Available on select models 
- ENHANCED AIRFLOW

 The ZOTAC GAMING graphics card enhances cooling performance by utilizing an 11-blade fan design. The curved blades optimized for static pressure can increase airflow by up to 10%*. The ZOTAC GAMING AMP Extreme Holo feature a larger set of fans with triple 100mm fans for maximum airflow dynamics. *when compared to the previous generation design at the same RPM 
- FREEZE FAN STOP

 Automatically enable efficient and quieter cooling by stopping the fans when the GPU is idle. The smart control results in lower noise levels and reduces wear and tear on the fan system, extending fan longevity. 
- ACTIVE FAN CONTROL

 Users have more control over the fans when using the ZOTAC GAMING FireStorm software. Adjust fan rotations independently and apply increased airflow only to where and when it’s needed. 

*On triple fan models, the LEFT and CENTER fans will spin at the same RPMs
- WIDE AND SECTIONED

 A wide aluminum fin-stack array heatsink sectioned in up to 3 groups and paired with up to eight copper heat pipes* span the length of the graphics card to extract and distribute more heat, more efficiently than before. 

*May vary by model
- MAXIMUM CONTACT

 A new and improved heat pipe layout is utilized in a more densely packed space. The flattened and vertically-laid heatpipes add up to 72%* more direct contact over the GPU to transfer heat efficiently and quickly away from the core. 

*when compared to the previous generation design
- DUAL BIOS

 Switch between the dual BIOS for your preferred fan profile.

...

- 16+3 POWER PHASE

 Power design for extreme performance and stability. Spreading the load to 16 power phases means that no one power phase is overworked and building up too much heat. With more distribution of power, experience unparalleled stability.

...

- POWERBOOST

 A control chip providing live electrical current regulation and instant electrical deviation responses.

...

MORE RESILIENT

The design of ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3080 12GB Series underlines durability from front to back with a full-board metal frontplate and backplate to increase the overall card rigidity and structural integrity. The AMP Extreme Holo features an additional retention mount to reinforce contact.

---
